description: Full-text search across every dated entry in the historical record, plus the subjects that match. Each entry is a sentence quoted verbatim from a numbered English Wikipedia revision and carries that revision id, so an answer built on it can cite a source that will still say the same thing next year. Use this whenever you need a dated fact.

from_year.description: earliest year; astronomical numbering, so -43 means 44 BCE

query.description: words to find, e.g. 'volcanic eruption' or 'Constantinople'

name: search_history
